results.title: Two `expires` conditions with different windows on one model
results.evidence: `conditions` reads 2, an integer. `for_model` builds `{"conditions": rows, ...}` and then spreads `**self.evaluate(urn)` over it, and `evaluate` answers `conditions: len(rows)` — so the spread overwrites the rows with a count, and the rationale, the imposer and the discharge reason never reach a caller of GET /approval-conditions?urn=
